title: NoticeToActionNotice
description: Standardized schema contract (v1.0) for evidence-linked extraction of official notices.

notice_id.description: Unique identifier for the notice processing job (UUID format recommended).

schema_version.description: Version of the notice contract schema.

category.description: High-level classification category of the notice. Unsupported notices must be classified as 'unsupported'.

title.description: Official title or subject heading of the notice.

issuer.description: Issuing agency, government department, institution, or bank.

summary_plain.description: Plain language non-technical summary of what the notice requires.

affected_party.description: Target audience or designated affected person/entity (e.g. Student, Account Holder).

deadlines.description: List of all deadlines mentioned in the notice.

required_documents.description: List of checklist documents mentioned in the notice.

action_steps.description: Ordered sequence of action steps directly derived from notice evidence.

submission_channel.description: Mode of submission or response (e.g., online portal URL, branch visit, email address, physical postal mail).

fees_penalties.description: Financial penalties, late fees, or required fees with evidence.

warnings.description: Uncertainty warnings, ambiguity notes, illegible scan alerts, or caveats.

document_quality.description: Assessment of input document readability and completeness.

page_count.description: Total number of pages processed in the notice.

extracted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when extraction was completed.

page.description: 1-indexed page number where the quotation was located, or null if not found.

quote.description: Exact verbatim substring from the source document backing this extraction, or null.

value.description: Extracted string value, or null if not found in notice.

label.description: Descriptive label for this deadline (e.g. 'Scholarship Portal Close', 'Objection Window').

original_text.description: Original raw date expression verbatim from notice text.

iso_date.description: Parsed ISO 8601 date string (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS), or null if relative/ambiguous.

explicitly_required.description: True if explicitly mandated by the notice; false if recommended or optional.

status.description: Verification status of the document requirement.

order.description: 1-indexed execution sequence order for this step.

text.description: Instruction for the citizen/recipient strictly derived from notice text.

status.description: Confidence status of this action step.

description.description: Description of the fee, late charge, or consequence.

amount.description: Monetary penalty amount or rate, or null if unspecified.

message.description: Human-readable explanation explaining what is uncertain or unverified.
